text: Nothing here was drawn. The sun printed it.
It begins with a brush, and two pale iron salts.
Green, and blind, until the light arrives.
But how long is long enough? Don't guess. Uncover the paper, one strip at a time.
Then wash it. Too little sun, and the picture rinses away.
Too much, and the shadows fill in.
Look for the strip where the white stays white.
Now the real sheet. A fern, a feather, and exactly that much sun.
Rinse until the water runs clear.
Hang it up. It darkens as it dries, so be patient.
Test a strip. Wait for gray. Rinse clear.
